label_notes: KNOWN GAP, spec-derived and documented, not fabricated. is_attack_signature() (agent_orchestrator.py) already detects a known attack-class keyword match today, but ONLY adds an informational note string to the L2 escalation reason for a non-malicious verdict (Phase 6) — it never actually appends Reason.ATTACK_SIGNATURE_VETO to any reason_codes list, for a malicious OR non-malicious verdict. Do not run policy replay against this case and treat a resulting mismatch as a bug in the case; it is the documented, expected state of a not-yet-implemented gate.
